summary.unknownIdScope: executionDiagnostic and executionRecordDiagnostic, before and after

interpretation.metric: Completed logical request measurements, not IndexedDB transaction counts.
interpretation.reset: shoppingPerformance.reset clears samples and increments generation. Completion callbacks from an older generation are rejected; they do not become samples of the next window.
interpretation.execution: Each window accepts 20 input calls with IDs 1,3,...39 and starts the same 20 save measurements with IDs 2,4,...40. Missing observations are a trailing prefix cut at read/reset.
interpretation.record: Each window has 135 input calls: one initial status change, 19 reentry cycles of six synchronous status changes, and 20 record submissions. Batched flushes start the same 40 logical request measurements: 42,44,51,53,...213,215. Every observed save vector is a strict prefix of this expected vector.
interpretation.cutoff: The test polls durable field values, not all request completion callbacks. It then reads diagnostics and resets before the next section. Remaining completion callbacks can be absent from the read and are discarded after reset.
interpretation.conclusion: All 72 input vectors match and all 96 execution/record save vectors match prefixes of their fixed expected request IDs with zero unknown IDs. The 12 increases and 11 decreases describe how far completion had advanced at the observation boundary, not newly introduced logical requests.
interpretation.limitation: These samples do not directly count physical database commits. applicationMutationCoordinator can commit multiple logical requests in one item batch and resolve each request separately.
